title: PrePay Power (Prepaid Metering) Activation Cover Days: Payment Arrangement History Table
content:
The activation payment of PrePay Power (Prepaid Metering) takes account of the member's record on Payment Arrangements (Deferred Payment Agreements): an arrangement whose unbilled balance was billed back for default, and installments that were missed, as the arrangement records of the member show them by their entry date.

**Rule.** Where a payment arrangement of the member had its unbilled balance billed back for default in the twenty-four-month window, the cover days are increased by 5; where no arrangement of the member was billed back for default in that window but an installment of one was missed in it, the cover days are increased by 2; with neither the cover days are not increased for arrangements.

A month window of a stated number of months covers the records dated after the same day of the month that many months before the current date, up to and including the current date.

| Billed back for default in the twenty-four-month window | Installment missed in the twenty-four-month window | Cover days |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | increased by 5 |
| yes | no | increased by 5 |
| no | yes | increased by 2 |
| no | no | not increased for arrangements |

Notes (hypothetical histories):
- A default billed back twenty-two months ago, with every installment since paid: increased by 5.
- Three missed installments in the window, no default: increased by 2; the increase does not grow with the number missed.
- A default billed back twenty-five months ago and nothing since: outside the window, not increased for arrangements.
